best_for: Home PC owners who need to know exactly what hardware is inside before an upgrade, or who must send their specs to tech support.

points.title: Your specs on one screen
points.text: It lists the CPU, motherboard, RAM, graphics card, storage and more in one window, so you do not have to dig through Windows settings or open the case.

points.title: Temperatures in real time
points.text: It shows live temperatures of key parts, which helps spot an overheating CPU or drive before it causes crashes.

points.title: Snapshots for support
points.text: Save a scan as a snapshot, XML or text file and send it to whoever is helping you, or keep it to check a new PC matches what you paid for.

points.title: What Pro adds
points.text: The free version has the same hardware details. Speccy Professional, listed at USD 19.95, adds automatic updates and priority support. A CCleaner Professional Plus bundle that includes it was shown too. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Home use only
points.text: The download page says both Speccy Free and Professional are licensed for home use. Businesses are pointed to a separate offer.

points.title: Old requirements list
points.text: The publisher's requirements still name Windows 10, 8.1, 7, Vista and XP and do not mention Windows 11, while the installer listed here asks for Windows 10 or later. It installs machine-wide. The latest build, 1.34.84 from June 2026, was a compliance update, and the listing keeps 3 versions.
